bookSourceComment: 秘密韩漫(mimihanman.com)，MCCMS漫画站。发现和搜索使用JSON API /api/data/comic。发现页带select切换分类/排行。API需带Referer。漫画源bookSourceType=2，正文为图片，用@js提取所有图片URL。
exploreUrl:
<js>
var result=[];
var tab=infoMap["分类"]||"分类";
var cats=[["都市","cid=5"],["恋爱","cid=6"],["校园","cid=8"],["萝莉","cid=9"],["正太","cid=12"],["淫荡","cid=13"],["出版漫画","cid=35"]];
var ranks=[["人气榜","order=hits"],["收藏榜","order=shits"],["最新更新","order=addtime"]];
result.push({title:"分类",type:"select",chars:["分类","排行"],default:tab,action:"java.refreshExplore()",style:{layout_flexGrow:1,layout_flexBasisPercent:1}});
if(tab=="分类"){for(var i=0;i<cats.length;i++){result.push({title:cats[i][0],url:"/index.php/api/data/comic?order=addtime&"+cats[i][1]+"&page={{page}}",style:{layout_flexGrow:1,layout_flexBasisPercent:0.333}})}}else if(tab=="排行"){for(var i=0;i<ranks.length;i++){result.push({title:ranks[i][0],url:"/index.php/api/data/comic?"+ranks[i][1]+"&page={{page}}",style:{layout_flexGrow:1,layout_flexBasisPercent:0.333}})}}
JSON.stringify(result);
</js>
